patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Always shows Samsung Notes in dark mode, whatever the system theme is.

patches.name: Force dark mode (any app)
patches.description: Shows the app in dark mode, whatever the system theme is. Uses the app's own dark theme, and can auto-darken apps that don't have one.

options.title: Auto-darken apps without a dark theme
options.description: Lets Android invert the colours of light-only screens (Android 10+). Turn off if an app's colours look wrong.
